mapper.select: SELECT * FROM `order` WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) FROM `order` WHERE status IN ('paid', 'completed') AND create_time BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end}

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS `date`, COUNT(1) AS `orderCount`, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('paid','completed') THEN total_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS `amount` FROM `order` WHERE create_time BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY 1 ASC
SELECT status AS `status`, COUNT(1) AS `value` FROM `order` GROUP BY status

SELECT COALESCE(a.province, '未知') AS `province`, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS `orderCount`, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.status IN ('paid','completed') THEN o.total_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS `amount` FROM `order` o LEFT JOIN user_address a ON o.address_id = a.id GROUP BY a.province ORDER BY `orderCount` DESC LIMIT 15
